info.title: Port_Access_Policy_Entry
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

class.description:
Reference Resource: [Class](#/Class)
The class associated with this policy entry. The class specified in this policy entry is defined in [Class](#/Class).

comment.description: Comment to associate with the specified policy entry.

origin.description: Origin of the policy, i.e., how the policy entry is provisioned.  `local`:           policy entry is provisioned locally on the device.  `downloaded`:      policy entry is downloaded from ClearPass server.  `radius`:          policy entry is translated from the attributes assigned                by RADIUS server.

policy_action_set.description:
Reference Resource: [Port_Access_Policy_Action_Set](#/Port_Access_Policy_Action_Set)
The group of actions associated with this policy entry. The entries group is applied to each entry of the associated class.The entries group specified in this policy entry is defined in [Port_Access_Policy_entries] (Port_Access_Policy_entries).

sequence_number.description:
Reference Resource: [Port_Access_Policy_Entry](#/Port_Access_Policy_Entry)
Policy entries as configured by the user. MAC based classes are not supported in a policy entry. The entire policy is rejected if it contains one or more policy entries with MAC classes.

parameters.name: Port_Access_Policy.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Port_Access_Policy](#/Port_Access_Policy)
Name of a port-access policy.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
